question: Can you describe a time when you used Python, SQL, or an LLM to solve a complex data problem, and what was the outcome?
transcript: In my previous role, our customer support team received thousands of open-ended feedback forms every day. I built a Python pipeline that cleaned the text, stored results in SQL, and used an LLM classifier to identify urgent bugs and shipping issues in near real time. The outcome was that critical problems were surfaced the same day instead of after a week.
